suite: the DAG zoom, Fit and the grid header
expect_red: [real] a zoom leaves the grid's sideways scroll at the left edge

mutations.contract: A zoom does not scroll the grid sideways under the DAG.
mutations.note: Declared with the guard by handoff the_wheel_the_column_and_fit_behave (2026-10-29). A zoom that nudges the grid sideways, as the old pointer anchoring did. Re-aimed 2026-10-30 (a_leader_starts_at_the_mark_it_names_on_every_tier): the grid is no longer scaled, so the wheel moves it sideways by nothing at all.
mutations.find: scrollDag(0, paneScroller() ? after.top + cy * to - clientY : 0);
mutations.replace: scrollDag(40, paneScroller() ? after.top + cy * to - clientY : 0);
